lines: Na samjho ke hum pee gaye peete peete
couplets.en: Do not think we merely drank the hours away.

lines: Ke thoda sa hum jee gaye peete peete
couplets.en: We lived a little as we drank.

lines: Na samjho ke hum pee gaye peete peete
couplets.en: Do not think we merely drank the hours away.

lines: Hamein seedhi raahon ne roka bahut tha
couplets.en: The straight roads did their best to hold us back.

lines: Qadam ladkhada hi gaye peete peete
couplets.en: Our steps faltered all the same as we drank.

lines: Ke thoda sa hum jee gaye peete peete
couplets.en: We lived a little as we drank.

lines: Na samjho ke hum pee gaye peete peete
couplets.en: Do not think we merely drank the hours away.

lines: Nahin dekhe saaqi ne hum se sharaabi
couplets.en: The cupbearer had never seen drinkers like us.

lines: Ke maikhaane mein bhi gaye peete peete
couplets.en: We were drinking even on our way to the tavern.

lines: Ke thoda sa hum jee gaye peete peete
couplets.en: We lived a little as we drank.

lines: Na samjho ke hum pee gaye peete peete
couplets.en: Do not think we merely drank the hours away.

lines: Kisi ne jo poochha ke kyun pee rahe ho
couplets.en: Someone asked us why we drank.

lines: To hans ke kaha, pee gaye peete peete
couplets.en: We laughed and said we simply went on drinking.

lines: Ke thoda sa hum jee gaye peete peete
couplets.en: We lived a little as we drank.

lines: Na samjho ke hum pee gaye peete peete
couplets.en: Do not think we merely drank the hours away.

lines: Nasha ho to kya khauf marne ka, Adam
couplets.en: With wine in your veins, Adam, why fear death?

lines: Ke hum qabr mein bhi gaye peete peete
couplets.en: We went to the grave still drinking.

lines: Na samjho ke hum pee gaye peete peete
couplets.en: Do not think we merely drank the hours away.
